today_summary: GCM26 marked $4,679.50, +$109.00 (+2.38%) from Friday's $4,570.50 and a new high for the 5-day window. Flow was violently one-sided: 20,417 call contracts against 5,612 puts (3.64:1), the heaviest call tape of the window and roughly 4x the 5,238 printed on 2026-08-18. ATM IV lifted to 24.77% even as price rallied, a call-demand vol bid rather than a hedging bid. Net GEX within +/-$200 of spot is +500.2, so dealers sit long gamma and are selling strength / buying weakness into the close.
five_day_thesis: Spot has added $206.50 (+4.62%) in five sessions, from $4,473.00 on 2026-08-18 through a single $4,420.00 dip on 08-19 to $4,679.50 today, and the option chain has been chasing rather than leading it. The tell is IV expanding +2.88pp (21.89% -> 24.77%) into a rally: premium is being bid for upside convexity, not downside protection, which is confirmed by the 5-day OI build concentrating in calls at $4,800 (+1,758), $4,500 (+1,578) and $5,500 (+1,019) against a lone defensive put build of +868 at $4,200. Max pain finally drifted $6,200 -> $6,000 (-$200), its first move in five sessions, but at $1,320 above spot it remains a structural artifact of legacy call OI rather than a tradeable magnet - the pain function still declines monotonically across the entire +/-$400 window, so the mechanical pull stays upward. The long-gamma cushion thickened materially, window net GEX +511.18 -> +879.78 (+72%), which explains why the advance has been a grind rather than an impulse. P/C OI is effectively frozen at 0.35-0.36 all week: this is a call-owned chain, and nothing in five sessions has challenged that.
what_changed: Call OI at $4,800 built +1,758 (3,972 -> 5,730), the window's largest single strike build and now the nearest real supply shelf above spot.
ATM IV expanded +2.88pp (21.89% -> 24.77%) alongside a +4.62% rally - upside convexity demand, not fear.
Max pain drifted $6,200 -> $6,000 (-$200), its first move in five sessions, still $1,320 above spot.
Call volume hit 20,417 vs 5,612 puts (3.64:1), roughly 4x the 5,238 calls printed on 2026-08-18.
Window net GEX deepened +511.18 -> +879.78 (+72%), thickening the long-gamma cushion that is damping realized vol.
Put OI at $4,200 added +868, the only meaningful downside build all week and 10.2% below spot - hedges are distant, not defensive.
prediction: Bias bullish while $4,600 holds, with the caveat that long dealer gamma (+500.2 net within +/-$200) caps impulse and favors a grind: 1-sigma daily is $73.02 (1.56%), so a $4,750 print is a full standard deviation of work. Path of least resistance runs $4,700 (3,888 call OI) then the $4,800 wall (5,730 call OI), where the week's heaviest build will meet supply. Invalidation is $4,510 - cumulative GEX turns decisively positive there on the back of the 11,012-contract $4,500 call wall, and losing it thins the gamma cushion and opens $4,500 then $4,400.
